purpose: Keep camera presentation tied to the active session and follow real intrinsic frame-size changes at an idle frame boundary.

contract.startup: No presentation commit after an obsolete video.play completion; Stop and replacement sessions retain their own UI.
contract.geometry: Resize from current intrinsic video dimensions with a 256-pixel long edge, rounded sides 64..256; reject unsupported extreme ratios instead of stretching the short side. Defer geometry changes until no bitmap/result is in flight; worker resets the existing Rust tracker when bitmap dimensions change while retaining AI initialization. Drop a bitmap if source dimensions change during async capture.
contract.verification: Reproduce stale-play and intrinsic-resize failures on the parent application with real browser synthetic streams. Test bounded aspect math, lifecycle/masks, actual WASM and AI, pause/backpressure, portrait/landscape and final public deployment. No physical-phone, Safari or metric-pose qualification.
contract.preservation: Preserve prior 493 scientific JSON, 42 frozen native artifacts, completed room/references, prior camera artifacts and resolved Cargo.lock. No Rust/GPU/native binary changes, sensor payload processing/download or fitting.

resources.strategy: Hard-link unchanged vendor assets from the completed local camera site, generate a separate site using the existing release WASM and matching bindgen CLI; no Cargo compilation, package/browser install or local static asset downloads.
resources.asset_download_scope: The zero asset_download_max_bytes budget covers new SDK/model acquisition for local builds. Separate post-deployment HTTPS checks may stream up to 32MiB without retaining vendor payload files; no new source/model acquisition is allowed.

remaining_80_percent: Canonical measured calibration/timing and independent motion, full-room accuracy, qualifying Linux hardware and integrated mapping/semantic/Viewer/interchange acceptance remain open.
